protocol_frozen_meaning: Phase 4 is an inventory task, not a preregistered experiment. The broader measurement/discrimination protocol (Phases 8-17) is not yet frozen.
scientific_results_note: Phase 4 produced a metric inventory. This is a measurement infrastructure artifact, not a discovery claim. M-008 is explicitly quarantined.

m008_quarantine.note: M-008 is the single most critical metric. It is the FP floor — if random candidates score near 1.0, the matcher does not discriminate. Current value 0.9189 is ~18x above the 0.05 acceptance threshold (MC-5: FP floor > 5% blocks discovery claims). It does not regenerate (fresh=0.8889, diff=0.030). Per audit round 6: no retroactive repair, no deletion, no replacement, no averaging. The discrepancy must be causally attributed before M-008 can be trusted.
m008_quarantine.what_m008_measures: M-008 measures the False Positive floor of the discovery matcher: what F1 do RANDOM candidates achieve when scored against the gold pool? A discriminating matcher should produce F1 near 0 on random candidates. If random candidates score near 1.0, the matcher does not discriminate at all.

m008_what_it_means_for_the_program.matcher_discrimination: M-008 IS the metric that determines whether the matcher is discriminative. The Phase 8-17 discrimination study depends on this metric being trustworthy. With M-008 quarantined, the discrimination study cannot proceed until the regeneration discrepancy is resolved.
m008_what_it_means_for_the_program.discovery_claims: Per MC-5, M-008 > 5% blocks ALL discovery claims. Current value 0.9189 means ALL discovery claims are blocked. This is not new — the Stage -1 audit already established this. The quarantine adds that the 0.9189 value itself is now untrusted.
m008_what_it_means_for_the_program.no_retroactive_repair: Per audit round 6: do NOT delete 0.9189, do NOT replace with 0.8889, do NOT average them. The discrepancy is an honest finding that must be causally attributed.
